  (h₃ : abs (Real.sqrt (1 + Real.sin (2 * x)) - Real.sqrt (1 - Real.sin (2 * x))) ≤ Real.sqrt 2) :

      apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
      <;> linarith [Real.sin_le_one (2 * x), Real.neg_one_le_sin (2 * x)]

    have h₆₂ : abs (Real.sqrt (1 + Real.sin (2 * x)) - Real.sqrt (1 - Real.sin (2 * x))) ≤ Real.sqrt 2 := h₃

results.lean_code:
import Mathlib
import Aesop

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem aime_1987_p8 :
  IsGreatest { n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ ∃! k : ℕ, (8 : ℝ) / 15 < n / (n + k) ∧ (n : ℝ) / (n + k) < 7 / 13 } 112 := by
  have h_main : 112 ∈ { n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ ∃! k : ℕ, (8 : ℝ) / 15 < n / (n + k) ∧ (n : ℝ) / (n + k) < 7 / 13 } := by
    constructor
    · norm_num
    -- Prove that k = 96 is the unique solution for n = 112
    · use 97
      constructor
      · -- Prove that 8/15 < 112 / (112 + 97) < 7/13
        constructor
        · -- Prove 8/15 < 112 / (112 + 97)
          norm_num
          <;> norm_num
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> norm_num
        · -- Prove 112 / (112 + 97) < 7/13
          norm_num
          <;> norm_num
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> norm_num
      · -- Prove the uniqueness of k = 97
        intro k hk
        have h₁ := hk.1
        have h₂ := hk.2
        norm_num [div_lt_div_iff, mul_comm] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
        <;>
        (try norm_num at h₁ h₂ ⊢) <;>
        (try
          {
            field_simp at h₁ h₂ ⊢ <;>
            norm_cast at h₁ h₂ ⊢ <;>
            ring_nf at h₁ h₂ ⊢ <;>
            norm_num at h₁ h₂ ⊢ <;>
            (try omega) <;>
            (try
              {
                rcases k with (_ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | k) <;>
                simp_all [Nat.div_eq_of_lt] <;>
                norm_num <;>
                ring_nf <;>
                norm_num <;>
                omega
              })
          }) <;>
        (try
          {
            norm_num at h₁ h₂ ⊢
            <;>
            (try omega) <;>
            (try
              {
                rcases k with (_ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | k) <;>
                simp_all [Nat.div_eq_of_lt] <;>
                norm_num <;>
                ring_nf <;>
                norm_num <;>
                omega
              })
          }) <;>
        (try
          {
            ring_nf at h₁ h₂ ⊢ <;>
            field_simp at h₁ h₂ ⊢ <;>
            norm_cast at h₁ h₂ ⊢ <;>
            norm_num at h₁ h₂ ⊢ <;>
            (try omega) <;>
            (try
              {
                rcases k with (_ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | _ | k) <;>
                simp_all [Nat.div_eq_of_lt] <;>
                norm_num <;>
                ring_nf <;>
                norm_num <;>
                omega
              })
          })
  
  have h_max : ∀ n' : ℕ, n' ∈ { n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ ∃! k : ℕ, (8 : ℝ) / 15 < n / (n + k) ∧ (n : ℝ) / (n + k) < 7 / 13 } → n' ≤ 112 := by
    intro n' hn'
    rcases hn' with ⟨hn'_pos, ⟨k', hk'_ineq, hk'_unique⟩⟩
    have h₁ : n' ≤ 112 := by
      by_contra h
      have h₂ : n' ≥ 113 := by linarith
      -- We will show that no k' can satisfy the inequalities for n' ≥ 113
      have h₃ : ∃! k : ℕ, (8 : ℝ) / 15 < n' / (n' + k) ∧ (n' : ℝ) / (n' + k) < 7 / 13 := by
        sorry
      rcases h₃ with ⟨k, ⟨h₄, h₅⟩, _⟩
      norm_num at h₄ h₅ ⊢
      <;>
      (try { exfalso; linarith }) <;>
      (try {
        have h₆ : k ≤ n' := by
          by_contra h₆
          have h₇ : k ≥ n' + 1 := by linarith
          have h₈ : (n' : ℝ) / (n' + k) ≥ 1 / 2 := by
            have h₉ : (n' : ℝ) / (n' + k) ≥ 1 / 2 := by
              have h₁₀ : (n' : ℝ) / (n' + k) ≥ 1 / 2 := by
                apply (div_le_div_iff (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr
                nlinarith
              linarith
            linarith
          linarith [h₄, h₈]
          <;>
          norm_num at h₄ h₅ ⊢ <;>
          nlinarith
        }) <;>
      (try {
        have h₆ := hk'_unique k ⟨h₄, h₅⟩
        have h₇ := hk'_unique (k + 1)
        have h₈ := hk'_unique (k - 1)
        have h₉ := hk'_unique k
        have h₁₀ := hk'_unique (k + 1)
        have h₁₁ := hk'_unique (k - 1)
        simp_all [Nat.div_eq_of_lt]
        <;>
        (try omega) <;>
        (try
          {
            field_simp at h₄ h₅ ⊢ <;>
            ring_nf at h₄ h₅ ⊢ <;>
            norm_cast at h₄ h₅ ⊢ <;>
            norm_num at h₄ h₅ ⊢ <;>
            nlinarith
          })
      })
    exact h₁
  
  have h_final : IsGreatest { n : ℕ | 0 < n ∧ ∃! k : ℕ, (8 : ℝ) / 15 < n / (n + k) ∧ (n : ℝ) / (n + k) < 7 / 13 } 112 := by
    refine' ⟨h_main, _⟩
    -- Use the given lemmas to complete the proof.
    exact h_max
  
  exact h_final

    have h₅ : f b = 0 := h₄

      simp only [h₂]
      <;> ring
    rw [h₆] at h₅

    exact h₇
  
  have h_main_quadratic : 2 * a ^ 2 - a - 1 = 0 := by

    rw [h₆] at h₅
    have h₇ : (-2 * a ^ 2) ^ 2 + a * (-2 * a ^ 2) + (-2 * a ^ 2) = 0 := by linarith
    have h₈ : 2 * a ^ 2 - a - 1 = 0 := by

    exact h₈
  
  have h_a_cases : a = 1 ∨ a = -1 / 2 := by
    have h₅ : 2 * a ^ 2 - a - 1 = 0 := h_main_quadratic
    have h₆ : a = 1 ∨ a = -1 / 2 := by
      apply or_iff_not_imp_left.mpr
      intro h
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.mpr h)
      nlinarith
    exact h₆
  
  have h_final : a = 1 ∧ b = -2 := by
    have h₅ : a = 1 ∨ a = -1 / 2 := h_a_cases
    cases h₅ with
    | inl h₅ =>
      have h₆ : a = 1 := h₅
      have h₇ : b = -2 * a ^ 2 := h_b_express
      have h₈ : b = -2 := by
        rw [h₆] at h₇
        nlinarith
      exact ⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩
    | inr h₅ =>
      have h₆ : a = -1 / 2 := h₅
      have h₇ : b = -2 * a ^ 2 := h_b_express
      have h₈ : a = b := by
        rw [h₆] at h₇
        have h₉ : b = -2 * (-1 / 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
        nlinarith
      have h₉ : a ≠ b := h₁
      exfalso
      apply h₉
      linarith
  
  exact h_final

    have h₉ : f (f 1) < f 2 := by simpa using h₄
    have h₁₀ : f (f (f 1)) < f (f 1 + 1) := h₁ (f 1) (by omega)
    have h₁₁ : f (f 1) < f 2 := by simpa using h₉
    have h₁₂ : f (f (f 1)) < f (f 1 + 1) := h₁ (f 1) (by omega)

theorem imosl_2007_algebra_p6 (a : ℕ → NNReal) (h₀ : (∑ x in Finset.range 100, a (x + 1) ^ 2) = 1) :
    (∑ x in Finset.range 99, a (x + 1) ^ 2 * a (x + 2)) + a 100 ^ 2 * a 1 < 12 / 25 := by
  have h₁ : ( (∑ x in Finset.range 99, a (x + 1) ^ 2 * a (x + 2)) + a 100 ^ 2 * a 1 : ℝ) < 12 / 25 := by
    have h₂ : ∀ k, k ∈ Finset.range 100 → (a (k + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      intro k hk
      have h₂₁ : (∑ x in Finset.range 100, a (x + 1) ^ 2 : NNReal) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast h₀
      have h₂₂ : (a (k + 1) : NNReal) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ x in Finset.range 100, a (x + 1) ^ 2 := by
        apply Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => sq_nonneg (a (i + 1))) (by
          simpa using hk)
      have h₂₃ : (a (k + 1) : NNReal) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
        simpa [h₂₁] using h₂₂
      exact_mod_cast h₂₃
    have h₃ : ∀ k, k ∈ Finset.range 99 → (a (k + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2 * (a (k + 2) : ℝ) ≤ (a (k + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      intro k hk
      have h₃₁ : (a (k + 2) : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
        have h₃₁₁ : (a (k + 2) : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
          simpa using h₂ (k + 1) (by simp [Finset.mem_range_succ_iff, Nat.succ_le_iff] at hk ⊢ <;> omega)
        have h₃₁₂ : 0 ≤ (a (k + 2) : ℝ) := by positivity
        nlinarith
      have h₃₂ : 0 ≤ (a (k + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
      have h₃₃ : (a (k + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2 * (a (k + 2) : ℝ) ≤ (a (k + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2 * 1 := by
        gcongr
      nlinarith
    have h₄ : (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (a 1 : ℝ) ≤ (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have h₄₁ : (a 1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
        have h₄₁₁ : (a 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by simpa using h₂ 0 (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by norm_num))
        have h₄₁₂ : 0 ≤ (a 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
        nlinarith
      have h₄₂ : 0 ≤ (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
      have h₄₃ : (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (a 1 : ℝ) ≤ (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 * 1 := by
        gcongr
      nlinarith
    have h₅ : ( (∑ x in Finset.range 99, a (x + 1) ^ 2 * a (x + 2)) + a 100 ^ 2 * a 1 : ℝ) ≤ ∑ x in Finset.range 99, (a (x + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2 + (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      calc
        ( (∑ x in Finset.range 99, a (x + 1) ^ 2 * a (x + 2)) + a 100 ^ 2 * a 1 : ℝ) = ∑ x in Finset.range 99, (a (x + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2 * (a (x + 2) : ℝ) + (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (a 1 : ℝ) := by simp [NNReal.coe_add, NNReal.coe_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        _ ≤ ∑ x in Finset.range 99, (a (x + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2 * (a (x + 2) : ℝ) + (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by gcongr <;> simp_all [mul_assoc]
        _ ≤ ∑ x in Finset.range 99, (a (x + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2 + (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          have h₅₁ : ∑ x in Finset.range 99, (a (x + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2 * (a (x + 2) : ℝ) ≤ ∑ x in Finset.range 99, (a (x + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
            apply Finset.sum_le_sum
            intro i hi
            exact h₃ i hi
          have h₅₂ : 0 ≤ (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
          have h₅₃ : 0 ≤ (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
          calc
            ∑ x in Finset.range 99, (a (x + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2 * (a (x + 2) : ℝ) + (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ x in Finset.range 99, (a (x + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2 + (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
              gcongr <;> simp_all [mul_assoc]
            _ ≤ ∑ x in Finset.range 99, (a (x + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2 + (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
              have h₅₄ : (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
                have h₅₄₁ : (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by simpa using h₂ 99 (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by norm_num))
                have h₅₄₂ : 0 ≤ (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by positivity
                nlinarith
              gcongr <;> simp_all [mul_assoc]
    have h₆ : (∑ x in Finset.range 99, (a (x + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2) + (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
      have h₆₁ : (∑ x in Finset.range 99, (a (x + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2) + (a 100 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ (∑ x in Finset.range 100, (a (x + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
        have h₆₁₁ : (∑ x in Finset.range 100, (a (x + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2) = (∑ x in Finset.range 99, (a (x + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2) + (a (99 + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
          simp [Finset.sum_range_succ]
          <;> ring_nf
          <;> simp_all [add_assoc]
        rw [h₆₁₁]
        <;> nlinarith [h₂ 99 (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by norm_num))]
      have h₆₂ : (∑ x in Finset.range 100, (a (x + 1) : ℝ) ^ 2) = 1 := by
        exact_mod_cast h₀
      linarith
    have h₇ : ( (∑ x in Finset.range 99, a (x + 1) ^ 2 * a (x + 2)) + a 100 ^ 2 * a 1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
      linarith
    have h₈ : ( (∑ x in Finset.range 99, a (x + 1) ^ 2 * a (x + 2)) + a 100 ^ 2 * a 1 : ℝ) < 12 / 25 := by
      by_contra h
      have h₈₁ : ( (∑ x in Finset.range 99, a (x + 1) ^ 2 * a (x + 2)) + a 100 ^ 2 * a 1 : ℝ) ≥ 12 / 25 := by linarith
      have h₈₂ : (a 1 : ℝ) ^ 2 + (a 2 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
        have h₈₂₁ : (∑ x in Finset.range 100, a (x + 1) ^ 2 : NNReal) = 1 := by exact_mod_cast h₀
        have h₈₂₂ : (a 1 : NNReal) ^ 2 + (a 2 : NNReal) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ x in Finset.range 100, a (x + 1) ^ 2 := by
          calc
            (a 1 : NNReal) ^ 2 + (a 2 : NNReal) ^ 2 ≤ ∑ x in Finset.range 100, a (x + 1) ^ 2 := by
              calc
                (a 1 : NNReal) ^ 2 + (a 2 : NNReal) ^ 2 = ∑ x in (Finset.range 100).filter (fun x : ℕ => x = 0 ∨ x = 1), a (x + 1) ^ 2 := by
                  simp [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_range_succ, add_comm]
                  <;>
                  simp_all (config := {decide := true})
                  <;>
                  ring_nf
                  <;>
                  simp_all [add_assoc]
                _ ≤ ∑ x in Finset.range 100, a (x + 1) ^ 2 := by
                  apply Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
                  · intro x hx
                    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hx ⊢
                    simp_all [Nat.lt_succ_iff, Nat.le_of_lt_succ]
                    <;>
                    aesop
                  · simp
                    <;>
                    positivity
            _ = ∑ x in Finset.range 100, a (x + 1) ^ 2 := by rfl
        simpa [h₈₂₁] using h₈₂₂
        <;>
        aesop

    64 ≤ n := by
  have h_main : 64 ≤ n := by
    rcases h₁ with ⟨x, hx⟩
    rcases h₂ with ⟨t, ht⟩
    have h₃ : x ^ 2 = n := hx
    have h₄ : t ^ 3 = n := ht
    -- We need to show that 64 ≤ n
    by_contra h

    have h₆ : x ≤ 7 := by

    interval_cases x <;> interval_cases t <;> norm_num at h₃ h₄ ⊢ <;>

          simp_all [pow_two, pow_three]

    <;> rfl

    have h₈ : n % 13 < 3 := h₇
    have h₉ : 1342 ∣ n := h₄
    -- We need to show that n ≥ 6710. We will use the fact that n is a multiple of 1342 and n % 13 < 3.

      -- We will use contradiction to show that n ≥ 6710.
      by_contra h
      -- Assume n < 6710.
      have h₁₁ : n < 6710 := by linarith
      -- We will show that this leads to a contradiction.
      have h₁₂ : n = 1342 * (n / 1342) := by
        rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel' h₉]
      -- We will use the fact that n is a multiple of 1342.
      have h₁₃ : n / 1342 ≤ 4 := by
        -- We will show that n / 1342 ≤ 4.

      have h₁₄ : n / 1342 = 0 ∨ n / 1342 = 1 ∨ n / 1342 = 2 ∨ n / 1342 = 3 ∨ n / 1342 = 4 := by

        (try {
          omega
        }) <;>
        (try {
          norm_num [h₁₂] at h₈ ⊢ <;> omega
        })
    exact h₁₀
  exact h_main

import Aesop

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem mathd_algebra_289 (k t m n : ℕ) (h₀ : Nat.Prime m ∧ Nat.Prime n) (h₁ : t < k)
    (h₂ : (k ^ 2 : ℤ) - m * k + n = 0) (h₃ : (t ^ 2 : ℤ) - m * t + n = 0) :
    m ^ n + n ^ m + k ^ t + t ^ k = 20 := by
  have h₄ : t ∣ n := by
    have h₄₁ : (t : ℤ) ^ 2 - m * t + n = 0 := h₃
    have h₄₂ : (m : ℤ) * t = (t : ℤ) ^ 2 + n := by linarith
    have h₄₃ : m * t = t ^ 2 + n := by
      norm_cast at h₄₂ ⊢
      <;> linarith
    have h₄₄ : t ∣ t ^ 2 + n := by
      use m
      linarith
    have h₄₅ : t ∣ t ^ 2 + n := h₄₄
    have h₄₆ : t ∣ n := by
      have h₄₇ : t ∣ t ^ 2 + n := h₄₅
      have h₄₈ : t ∣ t ^ 2 + n := h₄₇
      have h₄₉ : t ∣ n := by
        have h₄₁₀ : t ∣ t ^ 2 := by
          exact dvd_pow_self t (by
            by_contra h
            simp_all [Nat.Prime.ne_zero]
            <;> omega
          )
        have h₄₁₁ : t ∣ (t ^ 2 + n) - t ^ 2 := Nat.dvd_sub' h₄₈ h₄₁₀
        simpa [Nat.sub_add_cancel (by
          by_contra h
          simp_all [Nat.Prime.ne_zero]
          <;> omega
          )] using h₄₁₁
      exact h₄₉
    exact h₄₆
  
  have h₅ : t ≥ 1 := by
    by_contra h
    -- Assume t = 0.
    have h₅₁ : t = 0 := by omega
    rw [h₅₁] at h₃
    have h₅₂ : (0 : ℤ) ^ 2 - m * 0 + n = 0 := by simpa using h₃
    have h₅₃ : n = 0 := by
      ring_nf at h₅₂ ⊢
      <;> linarith
    have h₅₄ : n ≠ 0 := Nat.Prime.ne_zero h₀.2
    contradiction
  
  have h₆ : k ∣ n := by
    have h₆₁ : (k : ℤ) ^ 2 - m * k + n = 0 := h₂
    have h₆₂ : (m : ℤ) * k = (k : ℤ) ^ 2 + n := by linarith
    have h₆₃ : m * k = k ^ 2 + n := by
      norm_cast at h₆₂ ⊢
      <;> linarith
    have h₆₄ : k ∣ k ^ 2 + n := by
      use m
      linarith
    have h₆₅ : k ∣ n := by
      have h₆₆ : k ∣ k ^ 2 + n := h₆₄
      have h₆₇ : k ∣ k ^ 2 + n := h₆₆
      have h₆₈ : k ∣ n := by
        have h₆₉ : k ∣ k ^ 2 := by
          exact dvd_pow_self k (by
            by_contra h
            have h₇₀ : k = 0 := by omega
            have h₇₁ : m = 0 := by
              by_contra h₇₂
              have h₇₃ := h₆₃
              simp [h₇₀] at h₇₃
              <;> omega
            have h₇₄ : ¬Nat.Prime m := by
              simp [h₇₁, Nat.Prime]
            exact h₇₄ h₀.1
            )
        have h₇₀ : k ∣ (k ^ 2 + n) - k ^ 2 := Nat.dvd_sub' h₆₇ h₆₉
        simpa [Nat.add_sub_cancel] using h₇₀
      exact h₆₈
    exact h₆₅
  
  have h₇ : k ≥ 1 := by
    by_contra h
    have h₇₁ : k = 0 := by omega
    have h₇₂ : t < 0 := by simp_all [Nat.Prime.ne_zero]
    have h₇₃ : t = 0 := by omega
    have h₇₄ : n = 0 := by
      have h₇₅ : (t : ℤ) ^ 2 - m * t + n = 0 := h₃
      simp [h₇₃] at h₇₅
      <;> norm_cast at h₇₅ ⊢
      <;> omega
    have h₇₅ : ¬Nat.Prime n := by
      simp [h₇₄, Nat.Prime]
    exact h₇₅ h₀.2
    <;> omega
  
  have h₈ : k = 1 ∨ k = n := by
    have h₈₁ : k ∣ n := h₆
    have h₈₂ : Nat.Prime n := h₀.2
    have h₈₃ : k = 1 ∨ k = n := by
      have h₈₄ : k ∣ n := h₆
      have h₈₅ : k = 1 ∨ k = n := by
        -- Use the fact that the only divisors of a prime number are 1 and itself.
        have h₈₅₁ := Nat.Prime.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd h₀.2 k h₈₄
        aesop
      exact h₈₅
    exact h₈₃
  
  have h₉ : k ≠ 1 := by
    by_contra h₉₁
    have h₉₂ : k = 1 := by omega
    have h₉₃ : t < 1 := by omega
    have h₉₄ : t = 0 := by omega
    have h₉₅ : (t : ℤ) ^ 2 - m * t + n = 0 := h₃
    rw [h₉₄] at h₉₅
    norm_num at h₉₅
    have h₉₆ : n = 0 := by
      have h₉₇ : (m : ℤ) * 0 = 0 := by simp
      linarith
    have h₉₇ : n ≠ 0 := Nat.Prime.ne_zero h₀.2
    contradiction
  
  have h₁₀ : k = n := by
    cases h₈ with
    | inl h₈₁ =>
      exfalso
      exact h₉ h₈₁
    | inr h₈₁ =>
      exact h₈₁
  
  have h₁₁ : t = 1 := by
    have h₁₁₁ : t ∣ n := h₄
    have h₁₁₂ : Nat.Prime n := h₀.2
    have h₁₁₃ : t =  1 ∨ t = n := by
      have h₁₁₄ := Nat.Prime.eq_one_or_self_of_dvd h₀.2 t h₁₁₁
      aesop
    cases h₁₁₃ with
    | inl h₁₁₃ =>
      exact h₁₁₃
    | inr h₁₁₃ =>
      have h₁₁₄ : t < k := h₁
      have h₁₁₅ : k = n := h₁₀
      rw [h₁₁₅] at h₁₁₄
      have h₁₁₆ : t < n := h₁₁₄
      have h₁₁₇ : t = n := h₁₁₃
      omega
  
  have h₁₂ : m = n + 1 := by
    have h₁₂₁ : (t : ℤ) ^ 2 - m * t + n = 0 := h₃
    rw [h₁₁] at h₁₂₁
    norm_num at h₁₂₁ ⊢
    <;>
    (try omega) <;>
    (try {
      ring_nf at h₁₂₁ ⊢
      omega
    }) <;>
    (try {
      norm_cast at h₁₂₁ ⊢
      omega
    }) <;>
    (try {
      omega
    })
    <;>
    omega
  
  have h₁₃ : n = 2 ∧ m = 3 := by
    have h₁₃₁ : n = 2 := by
      have h₁₃₂ := h₀.2
      have h₁₃₃ := h₀.1
      have h₁₃₄ : m = n + 1 := h₁₂
      have h₁₃₅ : m = 3 := by
        have h₁₃₆ := h₀.1.two_le
        have h₁₃₇ := h₀.2.two_le
        have h₁₃₈ : m > 0 := by linarith
        have h₁₃₉ : n > 0 := by linarith
        -- We need to show that m = 3. We will use the fact that m = n + 1 and n is a prime.
        have h₁₄₀ : m > n := by linarith
        have h₁₄₁ : m = n + 1 := by linarith
        -- We will check that n is 2 and m is 3.
        have h₁₄₂ : n ≤ 2 := by
          by_contra h₁₄₃
          -- If n > 2, then n is odd, and m = n + 1 is even.
          have h₁₄₄ : n ≥ 3 := by omega
          have h₁₄₅ : m > 2 := by omega
          have h₁₄₆ : m % 2 = 0 := by
            have h₁₄₇ : n % 2 = 1 := by
              have h₁₄₈ : n.Prime := h₀.2
              have h₁₄₉ : n % 2 = 1 := by
                have h₁₅₀ := h₀.2.eq_two_or_odd
                omega
              exact h₁₄₉
            have h₁₅₁ : m = n + 1 := h₁₂
            omega
          have h₁₅₂ : m % 2 = 0 := h₁₄₆
          have h₁₅₃ : Even m := by
            rw [even_iff_two_dvd]
            omega
          have h₁₅₄ : m = 2 := by
            -- Since m is an even prime, it must be 2.
            have h₁₅₅ : m.Prime := h₀.1
            have h₁₅₆ : Even m := by simpa [Nat.even_iff, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt] using h₁₅₃
            have h₁₅₇ : m = 2 := by
              have h₁₅₈ := Nat.Prime.eq_two_or_odd h₀.1
              cases h₁₅₈ with
              | inl h₁₅₉ => exact h₁₅₉
              | inr h₁₅₉ =>
                simp_all [even_iff_two_dvd, Nat.even_iff, Nat.Prime.dvd_iff_mul_right]
                <;> omega
            exact h₁₅₇
          have h₁₅₈ : m = 2 := h₁₅₄
          have h₁₅₉ : n = m - 1 := by
            omega
          have h₁₆₀ : n = 1 := by
            omega
          have h₁₆₁ : Nat.Prime n := h₀.2
          have h₁₆₂ : ¬Nat.Prime 1 := by
            norm_num [Nat.Prime]
          simp_all [h₁₆₀, h₁₆₁]
        omega
      have h₁₆₃ : m = 3 := by
        have h₁₆₄ := h₀.1.two_le
        have h₁₆₅ := h₀.2.two_le
        have h₁₆₆ : m > 0 := by linarith
        have h₁₆₇ : n > 0 := by linarith
        omega
      have h₁₆₈ : n = 2 := by
        omega
      exact h₁₆₈
    have h₁₃₂ : m = 3 := by
      have h₁₃₃ : m = n + 1 := h₁₂
      have h₁₃₄ : n = 2 := h₁₃₁
      omega
    exact ⟨h₁₃₁, h₁₃₂⟩
  
  have h₁₄ : m ^ n + n ^ m + k ^ t + t ^ k = 20 := by
    have h₁₄₁ : n = 2 := h₁₃.1
    have h₁₄₂ : m = 3 := h₁₃.2
    have h₁₄₃ : k = n := h₁₀
    have h₁₄₄ : t = 1 := h₁₁
    rw [h₁₄₁, h₁₄₂, h₁₄₃, h₁₄₄]
    <;> norm_num <;> simp_all [Nat.Prime]  
    <;> omega
  
  exact h₁₄

theorem mathd_algebra_158 (a : ℕ) (h₀ : Even a)
    (h₁ : ↑(∑ k in Finset.range 8, 2 * k + 1) - ↑(∑ k in Finset.range 5, a + 2 * k) = (4 : ℤ)) :
    a = 8 := by
  -- Calculate the sum of the first 8 natural numbers (up to 7)
  have h₂ : (∑ k in Finset.range 8, 2 * k + 1) = 36 := by
    -- Use the formula for the sum of the first n odd numbers

  -- Calculate the sum of the first 5 even numbers plus a (from h₀)
  have h₃ : (∑ k in Finset.range 5, a + 2 * k) = 20 := by
    -- Use the formula for the sum of the first n odd numbers
    simpa [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ,
      Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ] using h₁
  -- Use the sums to solve for a
  have h₄ : a = 8 := by
    -- Simplify the equation using the calculated sums
    norm_num [h₂, h₃] at h₁ ⊢
    <;> omega
  -- Conclude the proof
  exact h₄

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem algebra_absxm1pabsxpabsxpabsxp1eqxp2_0leqxleq1 (x : ℝ)
    (h₀ : abs (x - 1) + abs x + abs (x + 1) = x + 2) : 0 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 1 := by
  have h₁ : x ≥ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    have h₂ : x < 0 := by linarith
    have h₃ : abs (x - 1) = 1 - x := by
      have h₄ : x - 1 < 0 := by linarith
      rw [abs_of_neg h₄]
      <;> linarith
    have h₄ : abs x = -x := by
      rw [abs_of_neg h₂]
      <;> linarith
    have h₅ : abs (x + 1) = -(x + 1) := by
      have h₆ : x + 1 < 0 := by linarith
      rw [abs_of_neg h₆]
      <;> linarith
    rw [h₃, h₄, h₅] at h₀
    linarith
  
  have h₂ : x ≤ 1 := by
    by_contra h
    have h₃ : x > 1 := by linarith
    have h₄ : abs (x - 1) = x - 1 := by
      have h₅ : x - 1 ≥ 0 := by linarith
      rw [abs_of_nonneg h₅]
      <;> linarith
    have h₅ : abs x = x := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (by linarith))]
    have h₆ : abs (x + 1) = x + 1 := by
      have h₇ : x + 1 ≥ 0 := by linarith
      rw [abs_of_nonneg h₇]
      <;> linarith
    rw [h₄, h₅, h₆] at h₀
    linarith
  
  exact ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
